blocks.value: Validating an email address with `String` methods takes a page of code, handles half the cases, and breaks the moment the rules change. A regular expression does it in one line.
The trade-off is real: regexes are dense, and a wrong one fails quietly. Treat this lesson as learning to read them first and write them second.
What you will be able to do
By the end of this lesson you will be able to:

items: Explain what a regular expression is and when to use one
Match characters with brackets, ranges, and the wildcard
Control repetition with the repetition operators
Use `Pattern` and `Matcher` to compile and apply a regex
